task.name: single_block_place
task.instruction_template: Put the {color} block into the {color} tray.

instruction_values.red: Put the red block into the red tray.
instruction_values.blue: Put the blue block into the blue tray.

task.source: external dual-SO101 MuJoCo project, scripted physical expert

active_arm_rule.rationale: the red tray is sampled on y>0 and the blue tray on y<0; the same-side arm is the only certified direct placement arm
active_arm_rule.other_arm: home park pose for the whole episode; no handover and no second-arm motion

source_binding.snapshot_policy: independent copy under the ignored cache root; the shared checkout and other workstreams' snapshots are never modified

state.timing: measured joint state immediately before the action is issued

action.semantics: absolute joint-position target, left six then right six
action.label_rule: clamped actuator target actually applied at that control frame; never the next measured state

color_balance.rule: exactly balanced over the 64 accepted episodes; a color shortfall is never filled by relabelling a scene

block_xy.source: certified pick points for the active arm
per_scene_checks: grasp IK at the sampled yaw
hover IK at the sampled yaw
approach and lift path screening with the other arm parked
projected footprint inside the table margin

block_yaw.domain_amendment: the initial [0,90) domain was rejected by the pilot: 39 of 65 place-check failures were at yaw >=75 degrees, and no accepted scene exceeded 70.7 degrees. The continuous domain is narrowed to [0,72); no check, limit or success condition is relaxed
block_yaw.rationale: the reference cube is square; the sampled domain is the measured place-feasible part of the square symmetry domain
per_scene_checks: placement descent and withdrawal screening at the sampled yaw

trays.candidate_region_status: frozen_after_pilot: x [0.21,0.27], red y [0.22,0.28], blue y [-0.28,-0.22]; measured displacement max 0.039691 m, 178/199 accepted scenes >0.01 m, 109/199 >0.02 m, 0/199 >0.04 m
constraints: tray footprint inside the table by at least 0.02 m
tray-tray outer-edge gap at least 0.03 m
block sampled outside each tray keepout: tray inner half-size plus 0.02 m plus 0.04 m block-tray clearance
chosen centre-slot release, hover, descent and withdrawal IK and collision screening
the same-colour centre slot is the only placement target; the two-cube slot offsets are not used
trays.slot_rule: place at the matching-colour tray centre slot; the two-cube slot offsets are retired for this single-block task because they put the opened gripper and the cube too close to the tray walls; record the centre-slot verdict

scene_layout.duplicate_scene_policy: a scene SHA-256 may appear once; a repeated draw is a rejected attempt, never a second episode

requires_all: the block is inside the matching-color tray using its rotated footprint against the tray inner half-size
the block is supported by that tray's floor geom (red_tray_0 or blue_tray_0)
no contact between the block and either arm (released)
block linear speed <= 0.02 m/s and angular speed <= 0.2 rad/s
the active arm and the other arm are at the registered home park pose within 2.0 degrees and 5.0 gripper percent
no contact between either arm and either tray
both TCP sites are at least 0.01 m from the block centre and from the tray outer volume in 3D (a TCP above a tray is clear; a TCP inside the tray volume is not)
all of the above hold continuously for at least 0.5 s
not_sufficient: a single frame of support or containment

scene_family.definition: family_key = (color, floor(block_x/0.0125), floor(block_y/0.0125), floor(tray_x/0.0125), floor(tray_y/0.0125), floor(yaw_degrees/15))
scene_family.rule: a family never crosses train/validation; a multi-episode family is assigned as one unit
scene_family.split_algorithm: per colour, greedily assign whole families to validation until 6 validation episodes per colour; skip a family that would exceed the per-colour quota; remaining families are train
scene_family.frozen_before: any normalisation statistic or training update

seed_registry.pilot_policy: a pilot scene is never reused as a demonstration; every executed pilot seed is recorded

layout_ik.acceptance_gate: at least 0.80 of attempted seeds produce a fully checked scene; otherwise shrink the tray region or yaw domain and rerun
layout_ik.record: per-seed tray positions, block XY/yaw, IK verdicts, collision verdicts, keepout verdicts, chosen slot

physical.acceptance_gate: at least 6/8 successes, no contact-guard or limit violation, mean successful-episode wall time <= 120 s
physical.yaw_gate: at least 2 attempts with yaw in [30,60) degrees; if the 45-degree band fails more than once, freeze yaw to the certified discrete set and record the amendment
physical.tray_gate: at least 4 attempts with a sampled tray centre more than 0.01 m from the nominal centre

formal.maximum_attempts_status: frozen_after_pilot: 199/200 layout seeds accepted, first-draw 41.7%, and 8/8 physical pilot successes; 128 physical attempts is a hard stop
formal.normalisation: computed from the 52 train episodes only
formal.failure_policy: every attempt is retained with its SceneSpec, scene SHA-256, IK verdicts, active arm, executed frames and failure reason; a failed attempt never becomes a demonstration
formal.observed_failure_note: all 14 physical failures were blue-arm: 9 high-yaw place_release contacts (60.3-69.0 degrees), 2 place_withdraw IK, 3 carry IK at low yaw with far block x; 2 blue scenes exhausted 400 sampler draws (place_checks/tray_keepout). No guard or limit was relaxed; the blue success yaw distribution is consequently truncated.

offline.acceptance_candidate: action L1/MAE and gripper-event timing gates are registered after the first checkpoint; no threshold is inherited from clean60
offline.loader_equivalence: same real frames through the training loader and the inference observation path
offline.inverse_action_check: real recorded actions through the actual output pipeline; never reuse old normalisation
offline.report: red and blue separately, with failure distribution by block position band and tray layout band

closed_loop.scene_freeze: SceneSpec and SHA-256 written before any policy rollout
closed_loop.success_predicate: the same physical single_block_place predicate, independent of the policy
closed_loop.allowed_after: offline acceptance passes and this scope is confirmed

freeze_scope.candidate: language backbone frozen with attention/MLP LoRA trainable; action expert full; SigLIP full; action/time projection kernels and biases full
freeze_scope.rule: no inherited count is accepted; parameter names, shapes, dtypes and trainable flags are re-measured before the formal run

devices.free_memory_source: measured memory.free on each selected device at admission
devices.gpu_coordination: shared registry; other workstreams' jobs are never stopped
devices.container_registration: full image digest, container name/id, run-id and owner are recorded before launch

training.circuit_breaker: host-side raw metrics; non-finite loss, allocation failure, host memory pressure or a lost device stops the run and is recorded

preflight.device_probe: not_run: no GPU occupied per user instruction
preflight.save_restore: not_run: no GPU occupied per user instruction

claims.engineering_chain: 64 successful single-block scripts-expert episodes -> audited train-only view and loader/norm/base/freeze preflight; the 20k training and offline policy evaluation are not executed because GPU occupancy was deferred by the user instruction
explicitly_not: proof of language-conditioned object selection: one block per scene and colour is confounded with the active arm
the 20k training or any policy evaluation was executed in this round

pilot_amendments.evidence: 39 of 65 place-check failures at yaw >=75 degrees; no accepted scene exceeded 70.7 degrees

pilot_amendments.from: two-cube slots at +/-0.0245 m along tray y
pilot_amendments.evidence: jaw/tray-wall contacts at place_release in 9/12 pilot attempts; centre slot maximises wall clearance for one block
static sweep: 40-50% hits the tray wall at yaw 60-70; 35% clears all tested yaw and still straddles the 45-degree square footprint
pick_close cube/tray contacts when the block was 0.0176 m outside the tray inner wall

pilot_amendments.to: TCP 3D distance to tray outer volume plus no robot-tray contact
pilot_amendments.evidence: parked TCP was above a tray at 6 cm but projected inside its 2D rectangle; 3 failures were false negatives
pilot 8/8 and layout 199/200; 2x the 64-success target as a hard stop

physical.note: the pilot stopped at the 8-success target; all eight attempts succeeded
